title: 省份数量
summary: 城市连接关系由对称邻接矩阵给出，统计传递连通形成的省份数量。
insight: 初始每个城市是独立集合，扫描矩阵上三角并合并直接相连城市，每次成功合并使连通分量数减一。
pitfalls: 矩阵对称只需扫描一半
间接连接由并查集传递维护

solutions.title: 并查集合并城市
solutions.idea: 路径压缩和按秩合并维护连通分量数量。
steps: 扫描 row<column 的连接项
根不同则 union 并 components--，返回 components

code.java: class Solution { public int findCircleNum(int[][] isConnected){int n=isConnected.length;int[] parent=new int[n],rank=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)parent[i]=i;int components=n;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<n;j++)if(isConnected[i][j]==1){int a=find(parent,i),b=find(parent,j);if(a!=b){if(rank[a]<rank[b]){int value=a;a=b;b=value;}parent[b]=a;if(rank[a]==rank[b])rank[a]++;components--;}}return components;}private int find(int[] parent,int value){if(parent[value]!=value)parent[value]=find(parent,parent[value]);return parent[value];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun findCircleNum(isConnected:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=isConnected.size;val parent=IntArray(n){it};val rank=IntArray(n);fun find(value:Int):Int{if(parent[value]!=value)parent[value]=find(parent[value]);return parent[value]};var components=n;for(i in 0 until n)for(j in i+1 until n)if(isConnected[i][j]==1){var a=find(i);var b=find(j);if(a!=b){if(rank[a]<rank[b]){val value=a;a=b;b=value};parent[b]=a;if(rank[a]==rank[b])rank[a]++;components--}};return components} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> parent,rankValue;int find(int value){return parent[value]==value?value:parent[value]=find(parent[value]);}public:int findCircleNum(vector<vector<int>>& isConnected){int n=isConnected.size();parent.resize(n);rankValue.resize(n);iota(parent.begin(),parent.end(),0);int components=n;for(int i=0;i<n;++i)for(int j=i+1;j<n;++j)if(isConnected[i][j]){int a=find(i),b=find(j);if(a!=b){if(rankValue[a]<rankValue[b])swap(a,b);parent[b]=a;if(rankValue[a]==rankValue[b])++rankValue[a];--components;}}return components;} };
